label: GO, confident a2 repeat after a rewarded a2 trial, late in the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the agent is about to choose a2 with a very strong policy (logit(a1)-logit(a2) < -8), the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1, 0 activations after unrewarded) and the previous choice was a2 (or is outside the window), i.e. win-stay on a2. It is also restricted to late episode: zero activations before ep_trial ~78; all activity in trials 80-99, captured by the model value output < 6 (value falls near episode end). Mostly when S2 is the good state (82% of mass). Never fires before a1 choices. Mass recall ~1.0 with precision ~0.65 on dev; the remaining false positives are the same condition where the unit stays below threshold. Magnitude appears to grow across consecutive rewarded a2 trials within a window (seen in examples, not formally checked). Uses no future variables: choice and value are the model own outputs at that step; the equivalent with action==2 (upcoming choice) and ep_trial>=80 scores F1 0.61.
